_note: Step order is the director's (M1): shelter, scared, hungry, alone. The opening 'observe' step teaches clicking an animal. All text is draft for the director to rewrite.

steps.title: A lonely wombat
steps.body: This wombat is scared, alone, hungry and has nowhere to shelter. Click it to see what it needs.

steps.title: No shelter
steps.body: Wombats rest in burrows through the heat of the day. Pick Burrow in the toolbar, then click the ground close to the wombat.

steps.title: Scared
steps.body: Litter and pollution around its home are frightening it. Pick Clean up, then click each piece of rubbish near the wombat.

steps.title: Hungry
steps.body: Wombats graze on native grasses. Pick Native grasses and plant some close to the wombat.

steps.title: Alone
steps.body: Its friends and family are hiding nearby. Clean up the rest of the rubbish and pull out the invasive plants. Once the land is healthy, they'll come out.

finale.title: Together again
finale.body: The wombat has found its friends and family. You've left this corner of the park better than you found it.
